products.title: Impact Long Sleeve
products.description:
Discover the perfect blend of comfort, performance, and sustainability with our sports bras, designed to keep you moving with ease. Engineered with smart fabric technology, our impact long sleeves are:
Breathable & Sweat-Wicking: Stay fresh and dry through every workout.
Quick Dry & Lightweight: Designed for maximum comfort and freedom of movement.
Four-Way Stretch & Active Stretch: Offers unmatched flexibility and support
Durable & Recyclable: Built to last while being eco-conscious.
Anti-Odor & Anti-Bacterial: Keeps you feeling clean and confident all day.
Sizing: Our activewear is designed to hug your body in all the right places with a snug fit. We recommend sizing up if you prefer a looser fit, it all comes down to personal preference!
